context: Decorative warning above browser authorization.
constraints: Remove only decoration. Preserve authorization gate, launcher ID and recovery actions.

context: Terminal access gate after initial StandTerm access.
constraints: Do not confuse browser authorization with launcher access or Agent access.

current_en: First time? Please use an Auth URL.
en: Paste a browser authorization URL to continue.
zh-TW: 貼上瀏覽器授權網址以繼續。
context: Instruction for the URL containing the one-time authorize grant.
constraints: Keep browser authorization URL distinct from the launcher Access URL.

context: Submit the browser authorization URL.
constraints: Button names intent; navigation and validation do not imply successful authorization.

context: Navigation after syntactic URL checks.
constraints: Do not say authorized or connected before the server confirms it.

context: Manual browser authorization fallback.
constraints: Downloading does not complete authorization; preserve adjacent manual placement help and automatic checking.

context: Browser cannot reach the Core service.
constraints: Do not assert the server has stopped, restarted or lost terminal sessions.

context: Explicit retry of the browser socket connection.
constraints: Does not resend terminal input, repeat a file copy, or reconnect SSH by itself.

current_en: StandTerm is not running or cannot be reached. This page will keep checking and reconnect automatically. If the server restarted, you may be asked for the current access token.
en: This page will keep trying to reconnect. If StandTerm restarted, use the access token from its current launcher.
zh-TW: 此頁面會持續嘗試重新連線。若 StandTerm 已重新啟動，請使用目前啟動器提供的存取權杖。
context: Adjacent explanation of automatic connection retries.
constraints: Do not imply terminal commands or failed transfers are retried.

context: Expired/missing session recovery dialog.
constraints: Restore UI access, not a terminated shell or a grant to every terminal.

current_en: Use a registered device to recover a live session, or enter the access token printed by the current launcher. A restarted server always requires its current token.
en: Use a device registered for this hostname and enabled for a still-valid session, or enter the current launcher’s access token. After StandTerm restarts, use the current access token.
zh-TW: 使用已於此主機名稱註冊、且已為仍有效的工作階段啟用復原功能的裝置，或輸入目前啟動器提供的存取權杖。StandTerm 重新啟動後，請使用目前的存取權杖。
context: Recovery eligibility and restart boundary beside short buttons.
constraints: Keep hostname registration, live-session binding and restart restrictions. Share the explanation across both surfaces; do not promise terminal process restoration.

context: Visible and accessible label for the recovery password input; also matches initial access form.
constraints: Explicitly identifies launcher access token, not Agent token. Empty baseline means new label on recovery dialog.

context: Submit token to /login on initial gate and recovery dialog.
constraints: Keep POST /login and token validation unchanged. Do not call this Agent authorization.

context: Platform credential verification; full eligibility stays in adjacent help.
constraints: Do not advertise as a bypass after Core restart or as proof that a registered/armed credential exists.

zh-TW: 使用已儲存的存取權杖
context: Use the existing browser token vault value.
constraints: Do not imply the saved token is guaranteed valid or that Agent credentials are reused.

zh-TW: 需要 StandTerm 存取權限
context: Separate server-rendered initial access gate.
constraints: This surface exists before the main template loads; preserve no-JS login fallback.

current_en: Enter the access token printed by the launcher, or open the full Access URL.
en: Enter the launcher’s access token, or open its full Access URL.
zh-TW: 輸入啟動器提供的存取權杖，或開啟其完整 Access URL。
context: Initial access token source.
constraints: Retain Access URL spelling used by the launcher; never replace with browser authorization URL.

context: Approve one exact pending terminal-input proposal.
constraints: Do not say Execute; input need not be a command and approval can still fail typed checks.

context: Approve the canonical file-copy proposal.
constraints: Keep endpoints, paths, size and replacement warning visible; direct input does not bypass approval.

context: Reject one pending input or file-copy proposal via agent_action_reject.
constraints: Does not disable Agent access, pause all operations or revoke a token.

context: Pause access for the terminal shown by the Agent panel.
constraints: Not equivalent to rejecting this proposal or stopping only this transfer.

context: Display action.ends_with_newline with localized yes/no.
constraints: Do not infer command execution from newline or inspect translated text for control.

context: Display action.contains_control_chars with localized yes/no.
constraints: Keep escaped_preview unchanged and safely rendered as text.

context: Canonical source endpoint and path label.
constraints: Translate only the label; preserve exact endpoint and path values.

context: Canonical destination endpoint and path label.
constraints: Translate only the label; do not replace paths with a friendly or editable approximation.

context: Source file size.
constraints: Do not confuse with the existing destination size in the replacement warning.

current_en: This will atomically replace an existing regular file ({size}).
context: Warning for replace with an existing regular destination file.
constraints: Keep existing destination size and replacement consequence; atomic implementation is not a user-facing guarantee of success.

current_en: The displayed destination is the exact keep-both name selected by the backend.
en: Copy to the destination shown; keep the existing file.
zh-TW: 複製到顯示的目的地，並保留既有檔案。
context: keep_both resolves a canonical destination before approval.
constraints: Do not imply the operator may edit this name or that the original destination will be replaced.

current_en: Replace was requested, but no destination file existed during preflight.
en: Replace requested; no destination file existed when checked.
zh-TW: 已要求覆寫；檢查時目的地沒有檔案。
context: Replace intent when preflight observed no destination file.
constraints: Describe the preflight observation; do not claim the destination remains absent or a race cannot occur.

context: Request cancellation before commit.
constraints: Keep existing cancellation barrier and disabled state; clicking alone is not confirmation of cancellation.

context: Show a pending cancellation request until backend result.
constraints: Display only while record.cancelPending. Do not map a request to stopped or safe destination.

context: Confirmed operator cancellation.
constraints: Use only file_copy_cancelled_by_operator; disconnect or generic failure does not establish that publication was prevented.

current_en: The destination is being published and cannot be stopped
en: Finishing the copy; it can no longer be stopped.
zh-TW: 正在完成複製，已無法停止。
context: Disabled Stop tooltip during committing.
constraints: Not a success or failure result. Do not enable Stop after the commit barrier.

context: Hide a finished transfer record.
constraints: Does not delete a file or cancel work. Preserve accessible name containing the filename.

current_en: destination may have changed; inspect it before retrying
en: Copy result unknown. The destination may have changed; check it before retrying.
zh-TW: 無法確認複製結果。目的地可能已變更，請先檢查再重試。
context: Ambiguous destination publication; show in Agent details and transfer queue.
constraints: Select by file_copy_publish_outcome_unknown. Retain diagnostic code, never auto-retry or claim destination unchanged.

context: Pending socket retry; reset to browser.connection.retry.
constraints: Plain text. Show only for the existing typed/local state; do not claim success or alter retries.

context: Pending access-token submission on initial gate and recovery dialog.
constraints: Plain text. Show only for the existing typed/local state; do not claim success or alter retries.

zh-TW: 正在驗證已儲存的存取權杖…
context: Pending submission of token-vault contents.
constraints: Plain text. Show only for the existing typed/local state; do not claim success or alter retries.

context: Pending platform credential ceremony on both access surfaces.
constraints: Plain text. Show only for the existing typed/local state; do not claim success or alter retries.

context: Unsuccessful /login response.
constraints: Plain text. Show only for the existing typed/local state; do not claim success or alter retries.
